description: Approaches for Assessing Flows, Concentrations, and Loads of Highway and Urban Runoff and Receiving-Stream Stormwater in Southern New England With the Stochastic Empirical Loading and Dilution Model (SELDM) [supporting d is a data set deposited in ROSA P by its authors Gregory E. Granato, Alana B Spaetzel. National Transportation Library (NTL) Curation Note: As this dataset is preserved in a repository outside U.S. DOT control, as allowed by the U.S. DOT’s Public Access Plan (https://doi.org/10.21949/1503647) Section 7.4.2 Data, the NTL staff has performed NO additional curation actions on this dataset. This dataset has been curated to CoreTrustSeal's curation level "C. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: ZIP. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-PDDC. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
